messages.text: Hello, I have a question before I order. My son has a severe tree nut and sesame allergy, and I need to know how you handle cross-contact in the kitchen. Could I speak with a person, please?
Of course. I can't confirm allergen details here, so I'll ask a staff member to message you shortly.
Thank you, I appreciate it. I'll wait to hear from them before ordering.

annotation_notes: An allergy question the menu can't answer goes to a person. No reaction is happening, so urgency is normal. Message 2 only thanks and waits: small talk. No order is built: gold_extraction is null.
